chunks: "Perform acts of kindness toward everyone. If he is deserving of it, then it belongs to him; and if not, then you are deserving of it."
ai.seo_question: Why should a person do good to everyone even if some people are not deserving of it?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that good should be done universally, without restricting it only to those whose merit is already known. The worth of righteous conduct remains with the doer even when the recipient does not deserve it, showing the intrinsic virtue of beneficence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1683 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Perform acts of kindness for everyone. If they are deserving of it, then it is for them; and if not, then you are worthy of it."
